It links representation geometry to where generalization fails, quantitatively, using a diagnostic computed from the IC alone before any test errors are seen. Distance of a query descriptor to the affine span of the five training descriptors has Spearman 0.895 +/- 0.031 with Reaction Fourier width-sweep error (raw 0.838, Fourier 0.806), better than nearest-profile distance (0.584). Latent diagnostics (pairwise distances, effective rank ~2, width-probe R^2 0.738 vs 0.470 for raw) and an exact raw-to-Fourier weight conversion (max discrepancy 2.6e-15) show why a linear basis change cannot add expressivity.
